test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements:

Some pens are pencils.

No pencil is eraser.

All erasers are pink.

Conclusions:

I. Some pens are pink.

II. Some pink things are not pencils.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58d54da5bf1b0a35944487f32371ab9b7a667f33a754e473036df9653bd96931.png] 

**Conclusions:****

I. Some pens are pink → **Does not follow** (There is no direct relation given between pens and pink. so, it is not follow).

II. Some pink things are not pencils → **Follow** (As all erasers are pink and No pencil is eraser. so pink which is also eraser never be pencil).

Only II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 2**”.
